      public static final int MAX_NUMBER_OF_RAT_KINGS_AFTER_CUTOFF
      The maximum number of rat kings that a team can have after the cutoff round. Rat kings created before the cutoff round are never destroyed, even if the team exceeds the new maximum.

      public static final int RAT_KING_CUTOFF_ROUND

      public static final long MAX_TEAM_EXECUTION_TIME
      The maximum execution time that can be spent on a team in one match. If the total time spent executing a team's bots exceeds this limit, the team will immediately lose the game. Execution time is measured in ns.
